name: IVR
tagline: International Association for Inland Navigation Safety and Standards
hero_kpi_rationale: L'organisation représente les intérêts du secteur européen de la navigation intérieure à travers des congrès annuels majeurs (225 participants en 2024) et des colloques spécialisés, démontrant un engagement fort auprès de ses 215+ membres issus de 11 pays européens.

kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress.
kpis.signal: Strong member engagement and international participation
kpis.description: Le congrès annuel IVR de 2024 à Francfort a accueilli 225 participants provenant de 11 pays européens différents.

kpis.explanation: Number of distinct European countries represented in the organization's membership base.
kpis.signal: Pan-European representation across inland navigation sector
kpis.description: Le congrès 2024 a rassemblé des représentants de 11 pays européens différents, reflétant la portée internationale de l'IVR.

kpis.name_fr: Participants au Colloque de Prévention des Sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium event.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of new specialized technical event
kpis.description: Le premier colloque de prévention des sinistres de l'IVR en novembre 2024 à Anvers a attiré environ 80 participants provenant de Belgique, des Pays-Bas et d'Allemagne.

kpis.explanation: Total number of members participating in the IVR association across European countries.
kpis.signal: Stable membership base across 10 European countries
kpis.description: L'IVR compte plus de 215 membres issus de dix pays européens, représentant l'industrie du transport fluvial intérieur, les assurances et les organismes de contrôle.

stories_kpis.title: 2024 Annual Congress in Frankfurt
stories_kpis.description: Successful organization of the IVR's annual congress featuring 225 participants from 11 European countries, including workshops on navigating the future of inland waterways and sustainability initiatives.

stories_kpis.title: Inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium
stories_kpis.description: Launch of the first-ever IVR Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp with 80 participants, addressing technical and financial aspects of damage prevention in European inland navigation.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or advanced digital technologies in the 2024 annual report. The organization focuses on institutional representation, regulatory standardization, and traditional safety practices in inland navigation.
evidence: No reference to AI, machine learning, APIs, or intelligent systems
Activities concentrate on institutional representation, safety regulation, and standards development through CESNI and ZKR
Mention of digitalization only in context of professional qualification standards, not AI adoption
Focus remains on traditional loss prevention, legal frameworks, and environmental compliance
